caption: The drawing depicts a wooden box or cabinet with open doors, mounted on four short legs. Inside the box is a three-dimensional scene resembling a diorama. The background is painted with swirling blue and dark clouds, accented with grapevines bearing purple grapes and large leaves. The mid-plane features a yellowish-brown, classical architectural structure with arches, columns, and three cupolas at the top. In the foreground beneath the arches stand five human figures, each dressed in robes or tunics of various colors: beige, green, white, and one in a prominent magenta or red cloak. Near the leftmost figure is a small human bust or statue at the base, and beside the central figure in magenta is an animal that appears to be a reddish-brown deer or similar quadruped. The ground under the figures is covered in painted stones or foliage, and there are additional plants and tree trunks flanking the scene on both sides inside the box.
title: Wax Group
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
